manifest.name: Peppol Business Response
manifest.summary: This module is used to send/receive responses to documents received/sent with PEPPOL

models._description: Send/receive Peppol business responses through the access-point proxy
Capability flag whether a participant supports the Invoice Response service
Registers the Invoice Response document type with the Peppol proxy

behavioral_notes.observation: Posting an incoming bill (in_invoice/in_refund) overrides account.move._post to automatically fire action_peppol_send_approval_response, which groups the can-send moves by company and calls company.account_peppol_edi_user._peppol_send_response(moves, 'AP'). Validating a received Peppol bill in Odoo therefore emits an 'Approval' Invoice-Response back to the document's sender. Gated by peppol_can_send_response (requires peppol_message_uuid, a vendor-bill type, the partner supporting the Invoice Response service, and no prior AP/RE/not_serviced response).

Builds and transmits a UBL ApplicationResponse (Invoice Response trns:invoice_response:3) through the Peppol access point by calling _call_peppol_proxy on endpoint '1/send_response' with params reference_uuids (origin message UUIDs), status (AB/AP/RE), and clarifications. Asserts status in {AB,AP,RE}; for RE it raises ValidationError unless at least one OPStatusReason clarification is supplied. On success it creates account.peppol.response rows (peppol_state='processing') and logs a chatter message (received/accepted/rejected); on UserError it logs the failure batch instead of raising.

Derives the invoice's peppol_move_state ('AB' Received / 'AP' Approved / 'RE' Rejected) from the response_code of related account.peppol.response records whose peppol_state == 'done'. Precedence is rejection-first: any 'RE' -> RE; else any 'AP' or 'PD' -> AP; else AB. This is the field that surfaces the cross-network accept/reject status of a document on the move.

On inbound polling, messages with document_type 'ApplicationResponse' are decoded and parsed with lxml: _peppol_extract_response_info reads DocumentResponse/Response/ResponseCode plus the Status/StatusReasonCode/StatusReason elements (listID OPStatusReason / OPStatusAction) to build a human-readable rejection/action message resolved against account.peppol.clarification. A new account.peppol.response is created against the origin move (matched by origin_message_uuid + company); when state=='done' a chatter log records that the receiver received / accepted / rejected the document.

response_code is a UBL/Peppol BLR code Selection: AB Acknowledgement, IP In Process, UQ Under query, CA Conditionally accepted, RE Rejection, AP Approval, PD Paid (only AB/AP/RE are actively driven; the rest are stored). button_cancel on a received Peppol bill opens account.peppol.rejection.wizard, where the user picks reason_ids (OPStatusReason, default 'unr', at least one required) and optional action_ids (OPStatusAction); button_send maps them to clarifications and calls _peppol_send_response(..., 'RE', clarifications) per company.

_peppol_get_documents_for_status appends 'processing' account.peppol.response rows to the proxy status batch; _peppol_process_messages_status maps proxy results back: error 702 ('request not ready') is skipped, 207 -> peppol_state='not_serviced', other errors -> 'error' with a chatter log, otherwise the returned state is stored. _cron_peppol_auto_register_services pushes supported Invoice Response document identifiers to the proxy ('/api/peppol/2/add_services') for every peppol receiver, re-triggering itself in 4h on failure.
No frontend: 0 JS files, 0 XML templates, 0 OWL components, 0 registry registrations, 0 patches, no asset bundles. UI is plain Odoo views (1 form, 1 list) plus the rejection wizard.

0 direct outbound HTTP call sites and no SDK imports in this module's static scan; uses_api_keys=False. All network traffic to the Peppol access point is mediated by the inherited account_edi_proxy_client.user._call_peppol_proxy (Odoo IAP/proxy) reached via endpoints '1/send_response', '/api/peppol/2/add_services' and the inherited status polling (gap #7: external integration through the EDI proxy).

it_architecture.application: account_peppol_response (Peppol Business Response extension of the e-invoicing stack; auto_install on account_peppol)
information_flows: depends: account_peppol (which itself depends on account_edi_ubl_cii + account_edi_proxy_client)
outbound: account.move._post -> _peppol_send_response('AP') -> IAP proxy '1/send_response' (UBL ApplicationResponse to the bill's sender)
outbound: button_cancel -> rejection wizard -> _peppol_send_response('RE', clarifications) with OPStatusReason/OPStatusAction codes
inbound: _peppol_process_new_messages parses ApplicationResponse -> creates account.peppol.response -> _compute_peppol_move_state sets peppol_move_state (AB/AP/RE) on the origin invoice
polling: _peppol_get_documents_for_status / _peppol_process_messages_status reconcile account.peppol.response.peppol_state against the proxy (702/207/error handling)

external_integrations.note: All Peppol network calls go through inherited account_edi_proxy_client.user._call_peppol_proxy (Odoo IAP/access-point proxy): '1/send_response', '/api/peppol/2/add_services', plus inherited status/receive endpoints.

capabilities: Send Peppol Invoice/Message-Level Responses (acknowledge / accept / reject)
Auto-acknowledge and auto-approve received Peppol vendor bills
Reject received Peppol documents with reason & suggested-action codes
Receive and interpret inbound responses to documents we sent (accepted/rejected/in-process)
Track per-document Peppol response status on the invoice/bill
Discover trading-partner Invoice Response service support
value_streams: Inbound-bill response: receive Peppol bill -> auto-acknowledge (AB) -> on post auto-approve (AP) or on cancel reject (RE) -> response sent to sender via access point
Outbound-document feedback: invoice sent over Peppol -> counterparty's ApplicationResponse polled/received -> parsed into account.peppol.response -> peppol_move_state updated (AB/AP/RE)
information_concepts: res.partner (trading participant + Invoice Response support flag)
policies: Rejection requires at least one OPStatusReason clarification (ValidationError otherwise; wizard defaults to reason 'unr')

A response is only sendable when peppol_can_send_response holds: vendor-bill type, existing peppol_message_uuid, partner supports the Invoice Response service, and no prior AP/RE/not_serviced response
Status precedence on the move: any RE -> Rejected, else AP/PD -> Approved, else AB -> Received (only 'done' responses count)
Only AB/AP/RE are the mandatory BLR codes actively driven; IP/UQ/CA/PD are stored but not acted on
stakeholders: Accountant / AP clerk (approves or rejects received Peppol bills)
Trading partner / document sender (receives the business response)
Peppol Access Point / Odoo IAP proxy (transport)
Tax / e-invoicing compliance authority (Peppol BIS / OpenPeppol)
metrics: peppol_move_state distribution (Received / Approved / Rejected) across moves

classification.rationale: account_peppol_response is an e-invoicing compliance/interchange extension layered on accounting (auto_install on account_peppol). It creates no primary customer value; it records and exchanges the compliance status of AR/AP documents on the Peppol network, classified as a Porter/Stabell support activity. Per APQC 9.0 Manage Financial Resources it sits in AR/AP processing (9.2.x process accounts receivable / 9.5.x process accounts payable): it sends accept/reject/acknowledge Message-Level / Invoice Responses for received vendor bills and ingests counterparties' responses to issued customer invoices, updating each move's peppol_move_state. The mediated network transport (access point / IAP proxy) is an interchange of compliance signals, not a value-chain output.

standard_capabilities: Auto-acknowledge (AB) inbound Peppol documents on reception
Auto-send Approval (AP) Invoice Response when a received bill is posted
Manual rejection (RE) with OPStatusReason + OPStatusAction codes via the rejection wizard on cancel
Parse inbound UBL ApplicationResponse and set peppol_move_state on the origin move
Reconcile response delivery status with the access point via the proxy status cron
Auto-register the Invoice Response document type/service with the Peppol proxy
typical_fits: OpenPeppol BIS Invoice Response (trns:invoice_response:3) accept/reject/acknowledge flows
AP teams confirming or rejecting received e-invoices back to suppliers
AR teams seeing whether a customer accepted/rejected an issued e-invoice
Partner capability discovery via SMP lookup of supported document types
common_gaps: Only AB/AP/RE driven; IP/UQ/CA/PD codes are stored but not workflowed
No public route / OWL UI — purely backend views + wizard
Requires a configured Peppol access point (account_peppol) registered as a receiver
Country/profile-specific reason-code catalogs beyond the seeded OPStatusReason/OPStatusAction clarifications
Outbound-response triggers tied to _post / button_cancel; custom approval workflows need extension
drive_hints: odoo shell: env['account.peppol.response'].fields_get(['response_code','peppol_state'])  # BLR code + state selections
odoo shell: m = env['account.move'].browse(<bill_id>); print(m.peppol_can_send_response, m.partner_id.peppol_response_support)

open_questions: Exact UBL ApplicationResponse payload built by the IAP proxy for '1/send_response' (the module only passes reference_uuids/status/clarifications; serialization lives proxy-side).
Full lifecycle handling intended for the stored-but-inactive codes IP/UQ/CA/PD if a counterparty returns them.
How frequently the status/receive crons run and the retry semantics for not_serviced (207) responses.
Seed contents of account.peppol.clarification (the OPStatusReason/OPStatusAction code lists shipped in data files).
